jobs.prompt: Match the reference images exactly: hand-painted storybook rendering, warm ink line, soft painterly shading, the game's 'Waiting Realm' theme (a dream-like waiting room / after-hours toy shop: dark lacquered wood, brass and gilt filigree, aged paper and ink, deep velvet, warm lantern glow, gentle melancholy with whimsy). A production UI SHEET for a SECRET EVENT screen (a mysterious side room where a strange visitor offers a deal on one of the player's relics), matching the UI kit in the references, 1536x1536 canvas: TOP a wide title banner plaque (dark velvet ribbon held by two brass hands, empty centre); MIDDLE-LEFT three tall offer plate frames side by side, same shape, each with a small empty round badge socket on its top edge: DO plate (aged cream paper with a brass rim), LOSE plate (dark oxblood paper with a thin thorn rim), GET plate (deep green-gilt paper with a laurel rim); a highlighted SELECTED version of the plate frame (glowing gold rim with tiny sparks); MIDDLE-RIGHT a small round relic PEDESTAL seen from the front (velvet cushion on a brass stand under a faint bell-jar glint, empty on top) with two small brass swap arrows on either side; BOTTOM a large confirm button shaped like a wax-sealed contract ribbon (normal, hover, pressed) and a small 'leave' door-tag button (normal, hover).
